metadata.organizing_institute: Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras)

subsections.title: Discrete Mathematics
topics: Propositional and first order logic
Sets, relations, functions, partial orders and lattices
Monoids, Groups
Graphs: connectivity, matching, colouring
Combinatorics: counting, recurrence relations, generating functions
subsections.prerequisites: Basic high school algebra and elementary set theory

subsections.title: Linear Algebra
topics: Matrices and determinants
System of linear equations
Eigenvalues and eigenvectors
LU decomposition

subsections.title: Calculus
topics: Limits, continuity and differentiability
Maxima and minima
Mean value theorem
Integration
subsections.prerequisites: Single variable differentiation and integration basics

subsections.title: Probability and Statistics
topics: Random variables
Uniform, normal, exponential, Poisson and binomial distributions
Mean, median, mode and standard deviation
Conditional probability and Bayes theorem

subsections.title: Boolean Algebra and Minimization
topics: Boolean algebra principles & theorems
Minimization – algebraic technique
Karnaugh maps (K-Map up to 5 variables)
Tabular method (Quine-McCluskey method)

subsections.title: Combinational and Sequential Circuits
topics: Combinational circuits (Multiplexers, Decoders, Encoders, Adders, Subtractors)
Sequential circuits (Latches, Flip-Flops: SR, JK, D, T)
Registers, Shift registers, Synchronous & Asynchronous Counters
State machines, state tables, and state minimization
subsections.prerequisites: Logic gates, truth tables, clock concepts

subsections.title: Number Representation and Arithmetic
topics: Binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal conversions
Signed number representations (Sign-magnitude, 1's complement, 2's complement)
Fixed point and floating point representation (IEEE 754 single & double precision)
Computer arithmetic, overflow, underflow detection
subsections.prerequisites: Basic arithmetic and positional numeral systems

subsections.title: Instruction Set and Addressing Modes
topics: Machine instructions & instruction cycle
Addressing modes (Immediate, Direct, Indirect, Indexed, Base-Register, Relative)
Instruction formats (0, 1, 2, 3 address architectures)
RISC vs CISC concepts
subsections.prerequisites: Assembly language overview, CPU register basics

subsections.title: ALU and Control Unit Design
topics: Design of Arithmetic and Logic Unit (ALU)
Data-path architecture and bus organisation
Design of control unit – hardwired control unit
Microprogrammed control unit (Horizontal & Vertical microprogramming)
subsections.prerequisites: Digital logic multiplexers, decoders, and registers

subsections.title: Memory Interfacing and Hierarchy
topics: Memory hierarchy levels and performance metrics (AMAT)
Cache memory mapping (Direct, Fully Associative, Set-Associative)
Cache write policies (Write-through, Write-back, Write-allocate)
Cache replacement algorithms (LRU, FIFO, Optimal)
Main memory interfacing & interleaved memory

subsections.title: I/O Interface
topics: Programmed I/O and Interrupt-driven I/O
Interrupt handling, interrupt latency, priority interrupts
Direct Memory Access (DMA): burst mode, cycle stealing mode, data transfer rate
subsections.prerequisites: Bus architecture and CPU interrupt cycles

subsections.title: Instruction Pipelining and Hazards
topics: Pipelining concepts, throughput, and speedup
Pipeline hazards: Structural hazards, Data hazards (RAW, WAR, WAW), Control/Branch hazards
Hazard resolution: Forwarding/Bypassing, Stall insertion, Branch prediction
Branch penalty and CPI calculation

subsections.title: Programming in C and Recursion
topics: C syntax, operators, operator precedence and associativity
Pointers, pointer arithmetic, double pointers, function pointers
Arrays and multi-dimensional arrays memory allocation
Structures, unions, dynamic memory allocation (malloc, calloc, realloc, free)
Recursion: base case, recurrence, call stack tracing, tail recursion

subsections.title: Linear Data Structures
topics: Arrays: representations, address calculations (row-major, column-major)
Stacks: array & linked implementations, infix to postfix, postfix evaluation
Queues: ordinary queue, circular queue, double-ended queue (deque), priority queue
Linked lists: singly, doubly, circular, reversal, cycle detection

subsections.title: Trees, BST, Binary Heaps and Graphs
topics: Binary trees: properties, tree traversals (Inorder, Preorder, Postorder, Level order)
Binary Search Trees (BST): insertion, deletion, search, AVL rotations & height balance
Binary Heaps: Min-heap, Max-heap, Heapify, Heap sort, Priority queue implementation
Graph representations: Adjacency matrix, Adjacency list, incidence matrix

subsections.title: Asymptotic Analysis and Complexity
topics: Asymptotic notations: Big-O, Big-Omega, Big-Theta, Little-o, Little-omega
Worst-case, average-case, and best-case analysis
Recurrence solving: Master Theorem, Recursion Tree, Substitution Method
Space complexity and auxiliary space

subsections.title: Searching, Sorting, and Hashing
topics: Linear search and Binary search
Comparison-based sorting: Bubble, Insertion, Selection, Merge sort, Quick sort, Heap sort
Linear-time sorting: Counting sort, Radix sort
Hashing: Hash functions, Collision resolution (Chaining, Open addressing: Linear, Quadratic, Double hashing)

subsections.title: Algorithm Design Techniques
topics: Divide and Conquer (Merge sort, Quick sort, Closest pair of points)
Greedy algorithms (Activity selection, Fractional knapsack, Huffman coding)
Dynamic Programming (0/1 Knapsack, Matrix chain multiplication, LCS, Subset sum, Optimal BST)

subsections.title: Graph Algorithms
topics: Graph traversals: Breadth First Search (BFS) and Depth First Search (DFS)
Topological sorting and strongly connected components (Kosaraju, Tarjan)
Minimum Spanning Trees: Kruskal's algorithm (Disjoint Set Union) and Prim's algorithm
Shortest Paths: Dijkstra's algorithm, Bellman-Ford algorithm, Floyd-Warshall algorithm

subsections.title: Regular Expressions and Finite Automata
topics: Deterministic Finite Automata (DFA): construction and state minimization (Myhill-Nerode)
Nondeterministic Finite Automata (NFA) and epsilon-NFA, subset construction
Regular expressions and conversion to finite automata (Arden's Theorem)
Regular languages, closure properties, and decision properties
Pumping Lemma for regular languages and proof of non-regularity
subsections.prerequisites: Set theory, strings, alphabets, and induction

subsections.title: Context-Free Grammars and Pushdown Automata
topics: Context-Free Grammars (CFG): derivations, parse trees, ambiguity
Chomsky Normal Form (CNF) and Greibach Normal Form (GNF)
Pushdown Automata (PDA): DPDA vs NPDA, acceptance by final state and empty stack
Context-Free Languages (CFL): closure properties, decision properties
Pumping Lemma for context-free languages

subsections.title: Turing Machines and Undecidability
topics: Turing machines: formal definition, transition function, multi-tape equivalence
Recursive (REC) and Recursively Enumerable (RE) languages
Chomsky hierarchy summary table
Decidability and undecidability: Halting Problem, Post Correspondence Problem (PCP)
Reductions and Rice's Theorem

subsections.title: Lexical Analysis and Parsing
topics: Phases of compiler overview
Lexical analysis: tokens, lexemes, patterns, regular definitions, lexical errors
Parsing: Top-down parsing (Recursive descent, LL(1) parsing, FIRST and FOLLOW sets)
Bottom-up parsing: Operator precedence, LR(0), SLR(1), CLR(1), LALR(1) parser tables and conflict resolution

subsections.title: Syntax-Directed Translation & Runtime Environments
topics: Syntax-Directed Definitions (SDD) and Translations (SDT)
Synthesized attributes (S-attributed) and Inherited attributes (L-attributed)
Runtime environments: storage organization, activation records, stack allocation, parameter passing mechanisms
subsections.prerequisites: Parse trees and function call mechanics

subsections.title: Intermediate Code Generation & Code Optimization
topics: Intermediate code representations: Three-address code, quadruples, triples, indirect triples, DAGs
Basic blocks and flow graphs
Local optimisation: Common subexpression elimination, Dead code elimination, Copy propagation
Data flow analyses: Constant propagation, Liveness analysis
subsections.prerequisites: Control flow graphs and assembly instructions

subsections.title: Processes, Threads, and Concurrency
topics: System calls and dual-mode CPU operation
Process state diagram, Process Control Block (PCB)
User-level threads vs kernel-level threads
Inter-process communication (IPC): Shared memory and Message passing

Concurrency and Synchronization: Critical section problem, Peterson's algorithm, Semaphores (Counting and Binary), Mutex locks, Classic synchronization problems (Producer-Consumer, Reader-Writer, Dining Philosophers)
subsections.prerequisites: Basic CPU execution and C programming

subsections.title: CPU Scheduling and Deadlock
topics: CPU scheduling algorithms: FCFS, SJF (Preemptive SRTF & Non-preemptive), Round Robin, Priority scheduling, Multi-level queue
I/O scheduling and disk scheduling algorithms (FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN, LOOK, C-LOOK)
Deadlock characterization (Coffman conditions)
Deadlock handling: Prevention, Avoidance (Banker's Algorithm), Detection, and Recovery
subsections.prerequisites: Process states and queue data structures

subsections.title: Memory Management and File Systems
topics: Contiguous memory allocation, Paging, Page table structure, Multi-level paging
Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB) and Effective Memory Access Time (EMAT)
Segmentation and segmented paging
Virtual memory: Demand paging, Page fault service routine
Page replacement algorithms: FIFO, Optimal (MIN), LRU, Belady's Anomaly
File systems: File allocation methods (Contiguous, Linked, Indexed/Inodes), Free space management

subsections.title: ER-Model, Relational Model and Calculus
topics: Entity-Relationship (ER) model: Entities, Relationships, Cardinality ratios, ER to Relational schema conversion
Relational model: Domains, Attributes, Tuples, Candidate keys, Primary keys, Super keys, Foreign keys
Relational Algebra: Select, Project, Cartesian product, Join (Natural, Theta, Outer joins), Set operations
Tuple Relational Calculus (TRC) and Domain Relational Calculus (DRC), Safe expressions
subsections.prerequisites: First order predicate logic and set theory

subsections.title: SQL, Integrity Constraints and Normalization
topics: SQL queries: DDL, DML, Nested subqueries, Correlated subqueries, Aggregate functions, GROUP BY, HAVING, NULL values
Integrity constraints: Domain, Key, Entity integrity, Referential integrity
Functional dependencies: Armstrong axioms, Attribute closure, Canonical cover, Minimal cover
Normal forms: 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF, Lossless join decomposition, Dependency preservation testing
subsections.importance: Very High (guaranteed questions on normal forms)

subsections.title: File Organization, Indexing and Transactions
topics: File organization: Heap, Sorted, Hashed files
Indexing: Primary index, Secondary index, Clustering index, Multi-level indexing
B-Trees and B+ Trees: Order, Search, Insertion, Deletion, Node capacity, Block access calculations
Transactions and ACID properties
Concurrency control: Serializability (Conflict serializability, View serializability, Precedence graph)
Recoverability (Cascading rollback, Cascadeless, Strict schedules)
Protocols: Two-Phase Locking (2PL), Strict 2PL, Rigorous 2PL, Timestamp ordering
subsections.prerequisites: Binary search trees and disk storage concepts

subsections.title: Layering, Switching and Performance Metrics
topics: Principles of Layering: OSI 7-layer model vs TCP/IP 4-layer model, encapsulation and de-encapsulation
Basics of switching: Circuit switching, Packet switching (Datagram approach), Virtual circuit switching
Performance metrics: Transmission delay, Propagation delay, Queuing delay, Processing delay, Bandwidth-Delay Product (BDP), Throughput, Efficiency

subsections.title: Data Link Layer & MAC
topics: Framing techniques (Byte stuffing, Bit stuffing)
Error detection and correction: Parity, Checksum, Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC), Hamming code
Medium Access Control (MAC): Pure ALOHA, Slotted ALOHA, CSMA, CSMA/CD (Efficiency, Minimum frame size), CSMA/CA
Ethernet standard: 802.3 frame format, Manchester encoding, Ethernet bridging and learning bridges
subsections.prerequisites: Digital logic parity and bitwise operations

subsections.title: Network Layer: Routing and IPv4
topics: Distance vector routing: Bellman-Ford algorithm, Count-to-infinity problem and solutions
Link state routing: Dijkstra's algorithm, Link State Advertisements (LSA)
IPv4 addressing: Classful addressing, Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) notation, Subnetting, Supernetting, Longest prefix matching
IPv4 Datagram Header and Fragmentation calculations (MTU, Offset, More Fragments flag)
Network Address Translation (NAT): Private IP ranges, NAT table operation
subsections.prerequisites: Shortest path algorithms and binary masking

subsections.title: Transport & Application Layers
topics: TCP flow control: Sliding window protocol, Stop-and-Wait, Go-Back-N, Selective Repeat (Window sizes, Efficiency, Sequence numbers)
TCP connection management: 3-way handshake, 4-way termination, TIME_WAIT state
TCP congestion control: Slow start, Congestion avoidance, Fast retransmit, Fast recovery, Congestion window evolution
Socket API: Socket system calls (socket, bind, listen, accept, connect, send, recv)
Application layer protocols: Domain Name System (DNS), Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP: persistent vs non-persistent, status codes, headers)

subsections.title: Verbal Aptitude
topics: Basic English grammar: tenses, articles, adjectives, prepositions, conjunctions, verb-noun agreement, parts of speech
Basic vocabulary: words, idioms, and phrases in context, antonyms, synonyms
Reading comprehension and passage inference
Narrative sequencing and sentence arrangement

subsections.title: Quantitative Aptitude
topics: Data interpretation: bar graphs, pie charts, 2D/3D plots, maps, tables
Numerical computation and estimation: ratios, percentages, powers, exponents, logarithms
Permutations and combinations, series, progressions (AP, GP)
Mensuration and geometry (2D areas, 3D surface areas and volumes)
Elementary statistics and probability

subsections.title: Analytical Aptitude
topics: Logic: deduction and induction, Syllogisms
Analogy and pattern recognition
Numerical relations and reasoning, Coding-decoding, Blood relations, Direction sense

subsections.title: Spatial Aptitude
topics: Transformation of shapes: translation, rotation, scaling, mirroring
Assembling and grouping shapes
Paper folding, paper cutting, and punch patterns in 2D and 3D
